method.scope: New infinite triangulations glued from RSST free completions. They are not intrinsic periods of finite RSST configurations or a reducibility proof.
method.seams: Each original boundary vertex retains motif ID and integer lattice offset; all original edges retained.
method.geometry: Selected cells: exact rational harmonic embedding, every positive face and every segment pair checked, full periodic edge incidences and links checked.
method.scan_scope: All 349 even-ring free completions: one balanced square boundary split, fixed original start. Combinatorial quotients only for the unselected cases.
method.period_scope: All 15 sublattices of indices 1 through 4 relative to the chosen geometric lattice; solver UNSAT has no archived formal certificate.
